links.outcome: Clinical decision quality (CDQAS) of residents using LLM with vs without structured ABCD guidance training
links.effect: Guided group had superior decision quality (CDQAS 16.2 vs 13.5, p < 0.05, d = 1.15); ACPQS 20.8 vs 15.1; evidence solicitation 3.0 vs 0.7 per case; 88% of improvement mediated by interaction process.
links.quote: The guided group demonstrated superior clinical decision quality (CDQAS: 16.2 vs 13.5, p < 0.05, d = 1.15), with significant gains in personalization and decision process completeness.
